hero.title: Building smarter solutions through expertise and collaboration.
hero.subtitle: We help organizations turn complex requirements into effective solutions through expertise in requirements management, technology, and agile development.

clients.title: Some of our clients
clients.subtitle: We are proud to collaborate with leading organizations and authorities in Sweden.

services.title: Our competence areas
services.subtitle: REQCON offers specialists across the entire IT development lifecycle, from the first strategic visions to continuous testing and QA.
services.cta_cta_title: Need reinforcement in an ongoing project?
services.cta_cta_desc: Our consultants are experienced in quickly integrating into existing codebases, data structures, and complex organizations to deliver results from day one.

krav.title: Requirements Analysis (Business Analysis)
krav.intro: The foundation of every successful IT project lies in understanding the true business needs.
krav.desc: Our requirements analysts are experts at translating complex visions into structured requirements documentation. We facilitate communication between business and IT, eliminating misunderstandings and reducing the risk of expensive errors.
bullets: Requirements management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps)

test.title: Testing & QA
test.intro: Quality assurance is not a final step – it is an integrated part of the entire lifecycle.
test.desc: We help you set up structured testing processes and perform thorough functional, usability, and acceptance tests. We ensure that the system performs safely, quickly, and exactly as expected.

pm.title: Project Management
pm.intro: We guide your project towards business goals, whether you work agile or traditionally.
pm.desc: With steady and methodical leadership, we ensure that schedules, budgets, and quality requirements are met. We coordinate teams, manage stakeholders, and establish transparency throughout development.

info.title: Information Management
info.intro: Create structure, security, and accessibility in your organization's information flows.
info.desc: We help you structure, organize, and store critical project information. With expertise in data coordination and document management (e.g., in SharePoint), we ensure that the right information reaches the right person on time.

ux.title: UX Design
ux.intro: User-friendly solutions are created at the intersection of form and function.
ux.desc: We find out what your users actually need through research and testing. Then, we design intuitive interfaces, user flows, and interactive prototypes that engage, simplify, and deliver results.

agile.title: Agile Methods
agile.intro: We coach and help your organization adapt agile principles to your needs.
agile.desc: Whether you want to implement Scrum at the team level or scale up to SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) at the organizational level, we help you build efficient, self-organizing teams and transparent workflows.
bullets: Agile coaching on individual & team levels

why.title: Why choose REQCON?
why.subtitle: We are not just consultants; we are your partner. We ensure structure, safety, and deliver real business value to every project.

items.title: Years of industry experience
items.desc: Our consultants have broad expertise from both public procurements and major private IT infrastructures.

items.title: Safe and stable delivery
items.desc: We work according to proven models that guarantee control, high quality, and structured milestones.

items.title: User-centric focus
items.desc: By combining UX and requirements management, we place the end-user's actual needs at the heart of the process.

items.title: Agile flexibility
items.desc: We master Scrum, SAFe, and traditional frameworks, and adapt the methods to your organization's unique conditions.

process.title: Our Work Process
process.subtitle: With a structured and proven working methodology, we ensure order, minimize risks, and drive development forward.

steps.title: Discovery & Analysis
steps.desc: We map business needs, conduct interviews with key stakeholders, and define the actual problem.

steps.title: Requirements & Planning
steps.desc: We specify functional and non-functional requirements, map out information flows, and plan test scenarios.

steps.title: Quality Assured Execution
steps.desc: We lead the development team, perform continuous reviews, and execute tests to fix bugs dynamically.

steps.title: Delivery & Handover
steps.desc: After completed system and user acceptance testing, we assure deployment and hand over a functioning product.

team.fadi_desc: Fadi leads the Stockholm office and is responsible for strategic partnerships as well as recruiting senior requirements analysts.
team.anel_desc: Anel is responsible for Western Sweden and matches complex client needs with the right testing and project management expertise.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: It started with a vision to gather expert IT specialists and build proven models based on practical experience. Today we are a well-established partner for digital success.
about.story_p1: REQCON was founded in 2020 in Stockholm. The vision has always been to gather a group of knowledgeable experts to build proven models and processes based on our know-how. We want to deliver real value to our clients - regardless of industry.
about.story_p2: Our foundation lies in requirements analysis (business analysis), but as a company we have recently expanded our competence areas to testing, project management, and information management. Today we have expanded operations to Gothenburg, and our ambition is to deliver expertise to organizations throughout Sweden.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.subtitle: Follow our journey from a newly started specialist firm to a nationwide IT partner.

items.title: REQCON is founded
items.desc: The company is established in central Stockholm with the goal of gathering the industry's top experts in requirements management and business analysis.

items.title: Competence areas expand
items.desc: To meet increased quality assurance demands from our clients, we recruit senior test leads, QA specialists, and project managers.

items.title: Expansion to Gothenburg
items.desc: REQCON opens the doors to its office on Gustaf Dalénsgatan in Gothenburg to support partners in Western Sweden locally.

items.title: Nationwide delivery
items.desc: With stable models and proven processes, we have the ambition to deliver our specialist services to clients throughout Sweden.

careers.title: Work with us
careers.subtitle: Want to join our team? We are always looking for senior requirements analysts, testers, and project managers who want to grow with us.
careers.benefits_subtitle: We value our employees highly and strive to create a balanced environment where you thrive, grow, and can make an impact.

benefits.title: Competitive Compensation
benefits.desc: We offer market-competitive salaries, great terms, and a generous wellness allowance.

benefits.title: Freedom under responsibility
benefits.desc: Here, you control your own time and workday as long as we and the client reach our common goals.

benefits.title: Competence development
benefits.desc: We invest in you. We offer both internal seminars and external trainings/certifications.

benefits.title: Career Growth
benefits.desc: There are excellent opportunities to take on expanded responsibility and grow alongside the company's expansion.

careers.expectations_subtitle: REQCON is built on mutual trust and professionalism. Our motto is: If you contribute to the company's development, the company will develop you – both competence-wise and economically.
expectations: That you take full ownership of your tasks and keep what you promise.
That you contribute to a professional, inclusive, and friendly work environment.
That you communicate openly, respectfully, and share your knowledge.
That you are curious, engaged, and have a constant desire to develop.
